boundary_decision.rationale: A building or engineered structure persists as one governed physical artifact while aggregating spatial parts, fabric, material and system bindings plus evolving observations and lifecycle events, so aggregate is more defensible than entity.

decisions.rationale: Building or structure owns persistent physical fabric, while Facility owns the managed operational aggregation. The existing Vercy Facility CONTAINS Building relation is retained with an explicit IFC type-hierarchy conflict.
The approved registry candidate WM-BLT-001 CONTAINS WM-BLT-002 expresses the spatial matryoshka, while independently governed premises keep their own identity and lifecycle.
The base covers roofed buildings and engineered works, but bridge, tunnel, tower, dam and other profiles must specialize geometry, components, actions, hazards and performance rules.
Designed, approved, as-built, surveyed and current observed geometry must remain distinct and carry CRS, units, accuracy, level of detail, method and provenance.
Geometry, dimensions, mass, materials, density, strength, hardness, fragility and surface properties belong in the physical model when observed with units, tolerance, conditions and time.
The structure owns system function, served scope, interfaces and dependencies while serial equipment identity, maintenance, warranties and spare parts remain external.
A defect observation or condition grade is not proof of current capacity, compliance or fitness. Engineering conclusions require competent authority, scope, method, evidence and limitations.
The incident remains external, damage is a building-local observation, assessment interprets it, restrictions are governed decisions and repair is referenced work execution.
Both standards provide valuable schemas and conceptual mappings, but neither serialization determines Vercy logical identity and every crosswalk must pin versions and disclose loss.
Directive (EU) 2024/1275 supports energy, carbon, renovation and technical-system concepts only where the relevant jurisdiction and implementation apply.
Physical removal changes lifecycle state but does not erase the asset identity, prior observations, legal references or provenance.
Every finding asks for subtype scope, source and method, observation time, accuracy and authorized revision. Machine-oriented repetition still requires later engineering-profile review.
